thread:
julia (PM): Heads-up: Beta account asked for an 'Overage Forgiveness' clause — forgive up to X% monthly overage once per quarter. They want it as a sellable add-on. Can we scope?

kevin (Sales): Customer will sign if we include this in contract. They need a clear UI toggle and billing math so finance teams can audit.

omar (Eng): Implementation: billing side tracks monthly overage amounts; product flags apply forgiveness during invoice generation. Low infra cost if it's a post-bill credit. Harder if we need real-time caps/blocks.

julia (PM): Proposal: v1 = post-invoice credit (forgiveness) with Console visibility; v2 = pre-emptive cap + auto-waive flow. GA requires legal wording.

sam (Solutions): Console needs a line-item in invoice, estimation in estimator, and an admin opt-in toggle for the add-on. Also docs describing eligibility and audit trail.

rita (Legal): I'll draft addendum: define forgiveness window, single use per quarter per customer, conditions (no abuse), and dispute process. Also require signed opt-in for the add-on.

kevin (Sales): For pilot, customer accepts post-bill credit. They want sample contract language before demo.

omar (Eng): Estimate: post-bill credit + UI flag = 2 sprints. Pre-emptive waiver + real-time detection = 4+ sprints. Recommend v1 pilot.

deploy-bot: feature-flag "overage-forgiveness-v1" created in staging.

julia (PM): Decision: ship v1 pilot (post-invoice credit + Console visibility). Actions: Omar -> RFC & tickets; Rita -> addendum draft; Sam -> estimator copy; Kevin -> pilot terms. Sync Tue 11am. :white_check_mark:
